crossRefs.note: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these…
“I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who…
But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be…
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…
If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served…
Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow…
My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred…
those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,
those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
“No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one…
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to…
If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

translations.web: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
translations.bsb: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
translations.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
translations.asv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
